notes: Two accommodation types: Suites (4 Double Suites + 2 Family Suites) and Tents (7 Double Tents + 3 Double Guide Tents). Rates only cover a 'Game Package' meal/activity plan - no separate Full Board-only rate is offered here (unlike some other properties in this project).
No alcohol is served on the premises (stated explicitly on every rate card).

STO discount confirmed arithmetically: Non-Resident STO = Rack x 0.75 exactly (25% off, e.g. Suites Peak: 1350=1800x0.75). Resident STO = Rack x 0.80 exactly (20% off, e.g. Suites Peak: 840=1050x0.8).

ANOMALY: The plain (non-STO) Non-Resident Rack Rate Card's Tents section states season dates as '10th June 2025-15th October 2025, 20th December 2025-5th January 2027' - mixing 2025 and 2027 years inconsistently, unlike every other season block in this document set (which correctly uses 2026/2027). Likely a copy-paste year error specific to that one file/section; the STO Non-Resident file's Tents section has the corrected 2026 dates. Season boundaries used below assume the corrected 2026 dates.
Camp reserves the right to change rates with only 48 hours' notice - shorter than most properties in this project.

nonResident_tents_perPersonPerNight.confidenceNote: [Unverified] The non-STO Rack file's Tents 'Extra Bed' figures (475 Peak / 300 Off-Peak) differ from the STO file's own Rack column shown for comparison (400 Peak / 300 Off-Peak) - a genuine cross-document discrepancy on this one line item, not reconciled. STO figures themselves (488/356) are still confirmed as 0.75x their own file's stated Rack baseline.
